_readme: Provenance and terms for every reference data file in this folder. workflow/reference_sets.py REFUSES to offer a file that has no entry here, or whose entry has no 'source' and 'terms'. That is how the credit condition of the Fogra grant is met by construction rather than by a reader's diligence (#182, docs/design/issue_182_answers.md and the specification in the research folder). The sha256 of each file is recorded so that 'distributed unmodified' is checkable.

FOGRA39.name: FOGRA39
FOGRA39.label: Coated commercial print, before 2016
FOGRA39.blurb: Sheet-fed offset on coated art paper, ISO 12647-2:2004/Amd 1. The condition behind ISO Coated v2.
FOGRA39.terms: Free use and redistribution of the Fogra characterisation data is permitted, including redistribution as part of commercial and non-commercial software, provided that the data are distributed unmodified and Fogra is identified as the source. The designation FOGRAxx may be used solely to identify the respective reference data. Such use does not imply certification, approval or endorsement by Fogra.
FOGRA39.print_conditions: Offset printing, according to ISO 12647-2:2004/Amd 1, OFCOM, paper type 1 or 2 = coated art, 115 g/m2, tone value increase curves A (CMY) and B (K)
FOGRA39.instrumentation: D50, 2 degree, geometry 45/0, no polarisation filter, white backing, according to ISO 13655
